# Parser fixtures

These minimal HTML inputs were authored for this project using fictional names, IDs and event details. They are not downloaded website pages. The example.invalid image URL tests that images are ignored; it must never be fetched.

Keep only markup necessary to exercise the parser. Do not paste third-party pages, tracking scripts, CSRF tokens, real image URLs or copyrighted descriptions. Record parser regressions using synthetic inputs.

The old downloaded fixtures remain in Git history: replacing the files does not clear historical redistribution rights. See OPEN_SOURCE.md before publication.
